name: @chordifree/desktop-spike
description: Electron desktop shell for the local Chordifree stack
author: Chordifree contributors

scripts.dist:win: pnpm build:server && pnpm resources && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build:server && pnpm resources && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build:server && pnpm resources && ./make-icns.sh && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
